infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Level Up Life needs your location to analyze the neighborhood you're in and show you what it takes to live there.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Level Up Life uses your camera to snap photos of neighborhoods you're curious about.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Level Up Life accesses your photos to read location data from images you've taken.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Level Up Life to use your location to analyze neighborhoods.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Level Up Life to access your photos to read location data.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Level Up Life to use your camera to capture neighborhood photos.
